description: This source file defines the HomeActivity class for an Android TV application, implementing the main home screen UI with focusable elements, content rails loaded from an API, and custom D-pad navigation logic to remap focus movements across UI components.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity for the home screen of the TV app, handling UI setup, focus navigation, and content loading.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI components, and triggers data loading.

methods.name: setupTopMenu
methods.description: Configures the top menu focusable items and click handlers.

methods.name: setupRails
methods.description: Loads content categories, populates content rails with items, and sets up D-pad navigation logic and focus management for each content card.

methods.name: handleDpadUpWithinRails
methods.description: Custom logic to remap focus on DPAD_UP within content rails to move focus to the corresponding item in the row above, or handle boundary cases.
